label: Fixed possible-fact domain in…: The domain of possible concrete facts is fixed across worlds…
term: fixed possible-fact domain in Koons1996 modal mereology
definition: The domain of possible concrete facts is fixed across worlds; actuality is the obtaining predicate on that domain. The specified modal resources are T and Barcan/converse-Barcan. This fixes fact quantifier domain, not automatically a world-independent ordinary-being constituent set for each fact.
note: Editorial scope glossary for §3physicalp3. Fact/proposition distinction and fixed fact-domain semantics do not establish bearer constitution, real membership in an arbitrary K assignment or all-world realization.
